cause: FQ3'24 revenue +50% YoY to $288M, net income more than doubled to $46.2M/$3.79 EPS, gross margin hit decade-high 28.4% (+620bps YoY), backlog holds at record $1.3B with book-to-bill 1.2x and 60% now convertible within 12 months
quality: 经营性持续: this is the third consecutive strong beat-quarter for Powell (following Jan-24 and May-24 already judged true), with margin expansion broadening across previously lower-margin non-industrial segments, and management explicitly guiding confidence to sustain performance into Q4 and FY25 entry
reason: Three-quarters-running pattern of real earnings beats with expanding, decade-high margins and a still-record $1.3B backlog is a strong durable trend, not a one-off. Positive OCF ($13.8M) comfortably funds modest capex ($1.4M plus planned $11M factory addition), no cash flow stress. Hurricane-related downtime was a minor, already-absorbed disruption with no material Q4 impact expected.
